interpreted_intent: Test conspicuous luxury as an original, highly prominent, coherently repeated non-letter house-code system integrated into a constructed object inside an unrelated complex orbital-travel narrative.

setting: A rain-lashed brutalist orbital ferry terminal at night during a one-minute launch countdown.
event: She rotates the case toward press cameras so its original emblem, repeated motif, seams, and hardware become readable together.

baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic editorial photograph of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and calm focused poise. In a rain-lashed orbital ferry terminal at night, she rotates a sculptural oxblood-and-black leather diplomatic case toward press cameras during a one-minute launch countdown. The case carries a large original non-letter emblem formed from an asymmetrical crescent and stepped hexagon, with the same geometric code repeating at controlled scale across the side panels and brushed-metal latch. The emblem is embossed into the leather and precisely aligned with seams, reinforced edges, and hardware, making the mark, repetition, and construction readable together. Use a three-quarter full figure with a detailed object foreground, wet brutalist concrete, blue launch light, warm reflected metal, and crisp leather grain. Blank label plates and abstract symbols keep the design fictional and brand-neutral.
